name: Circle of the Moon
summary: Shapeshifters who fight in powerful beast forms.

features.name: Combat Wild Shape
features.short: Wild Shape as a bonus action; heal by spending slots.
features.summary: You can use Wild Shape as a bonus action. While transformed, you can use a bonus action to expend a spell slot and regain 1d8 hit points per slot level.

features.name: Circle Forms
features.short: Turn into stronger beasts (CR 1, later CR = level / 3).
features.summary: You can transform into a beast with a challenge rating as high as 1 (ignoring the normal Max CR column). From 6th level, the limit is your druid level divided by 3, rounded down.

features.name: Primal Strike
features.summary: Your attacks in beast form count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity.

features.name: Elemental Wild Shape
features.short: Spend two Wild Shapes to become an elemental.
features.summary: You can expend two uses of Wild Shape at once to transform into an air, earth, fire or water elemental.

features.name: Thousand Forms
features.summary: You can cast the Alter Self spell at will.
